name: Tuscan white bean and kale stew
steps: Soften the diced onion, carrot, and garlic in the olive oil.
Add the tinned tomatoes and a splash of water and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the white beans and cooked kale.
Simmer gently for fifteen minutes until thick and fragrant.
Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
